senses.en_definition: Used before a clock time to indicate a particular time of day.
To hit, knock, or strike; in cooking, to beat or whisk eggs.
The act of hitting or beating someone or something.

messages.en: What time shall we meet tonight? I finish work at seven.
How about eight at our usual place? You'll have time to go home and shower first.
Yeah, but I still hit it out sometimes. Need to work on my accuracy a bit more.

senses.en_definition: Again; once more, indicating that something recurs.
Moreover; furthermore; especially, adding a reason or giving something greater emphasis.
Also; in turn; as for, shifting attention to another person or situation.
Used in questions to express surprise, puzzlement, or disbelief.

messages.en: Have you left yet? I'm waiting in the lobby.
I was just about to leave, and now it's raining. Hang on a sec, I've no idea where my umbrella is.
No worries, I've got a spare umbrella. I'll bring it up to you.

senses.en_definition: To go home or return to one's place of origin or where one belongs.
To fall to someone, be left to their decision, or be their responsibility, usually followed by kepada.

collocations.en: this matter is for Father to decide
if anything happens, you will be responsible

messages.en: Mum, I'm heading home now. Need me to pick anything up?
Get a tray of eggs, please. We've only got two left at home.
Okay, I'll stop by the shop first. If traffic's clear, I'll be home at seven.
